title: Rubric weights compute the headline: contributions that sum to the case score
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set grew by test_devcase_eval.py only (the Row.overall acceptance case lives beside the gate it pins) - tests are allowed. (2) User vocabulary: devcase-vocabulary.test.ts bans 'case' in devcase.* English copy, so the UI and the four-language _DET rationale say 'assignment score' (cs skore zadani / de Aufgabenwert / fr score de l'exercice); identifiers stay overallScore / rubric_composite / caseScore keys. This took a second catalog commit (3db171625) after the first (6a0558d14) went red on that guard. (3) Missing dimension: BOTH excluded with renormalised weights (stated in missingDimensions + scoredWeight) AND confidence scaled by scoredWeight; a keyless transfer with nothing scored falls back to 50 at confidence 0. (4) Added one case beyond the card (headline pinned to the rows' sum on divergence, from the registry technique's procedure step 3), and headlineFor takes the panel's breakdown as a fallback row source. (5) Missing rows keep MISSING_DIMENSION_SCORE as the bar's DISPLAY seed (DimensionScore.score is an int, DevScoreBar.tsx outside the write set) but show 'not scored' in place of a contribution. (6) scoredWeight/missingDimensions/weightsNormalised added to CaseEvaluation + CaseEval beyond the card's two fields, to state the exclusion.
